# Sofia Kenin defeats Venus Williams with late burst at 2026 US Open

Robbie Frischling-Sosman/

Monday, August 31, 2026

Text Size:

-

+

WHAT HAPPENED

Sofia Kenin defeated Venus Williams by winning the final six points of their 2026 US Open first-round match, saving seven set points in the second set.

Kenin, the 2020 Australian Open champion, escaped with a 6-2, 7-6(6) victory to set up a second-round meeting with Jessica Pegula. [...] Jumping out to a 6-2, 4-2 lead, Kenin looked to be cruising toward Round 2 until Venus turned back the clock. The 46-year-old surged ahead in a thrilling second set, earned three set points on return at 5-4 and ultimately forced a tiebreak.
